svg.title: Claymark icon (maskable)
svg.desc: Per the maskable-icon spec: the background fills the entire canvas edge to edge (no baked-in corner rounding — the OS applies its own mask shape and would otherwise show transparent corners peeking through its own rounding), and the letterform sits inside the standard ~80%-diameter safe-zone circle so no launcher mask shape clips it. The "C" here is the same size/position as icon-c.svg's — its 150px outer radius already sits inside the ~205px safe radius on this 512 canvas, confirmed by the numbers, not assumed.
